extracted.name: Vegan Chili and Sweet Cornbread!
extracted.description: This is easy and impressive for the non vegans in your family! #VeganOptions #Chili
ingredient_lines: FOR CORNBREAD preheat oven 400 degrees F
1 can rinsed chickpeas (or whatever beans you have on hand)
1 can rinsed kidney beans (or whatever beans you have on hand)
instruction_lines: Combine ingredients whisk dry together then add wet ingredients
Place in pan of your choice (smaller the pan the thicker the cornbread). I used a 7 in circle pan
Bake for 20-25 min. Or until golden
While cornbread is in the oven add 11/2 tsp of oil in a pot/ sauce pan add onions and peppers
Sauté veggies about 3 -5 mins then add your rinsed beans. Mix everything together and add your spices. Coat everything in the spices
Now add your veggie stock to deglaze the pan a little. Add more stock later if you want a little looser

Add the tomato sauce. If you like thick chili just add half a jar. For Saucey chili add the whole jar. I use the whole jar.Mix everything together and reduce at medium low heat. After about 10 mins. Taste. Add more flavor if you feel it needs more.
Let simmer for 15 min or more/less. Chili is done. Cornbread should be done around the same time. Personalize the chili to your liking
